integrity: Proof is self-contained modulo cited classical genus, p-rank and Castelnuovo-Severi formulas. Finite code is corroboration for n=5 and n=7, not proof for all n.
scientific_limitations: Classification is restricted to the specified irreducible-denominator family and n >= 5 with gcd(n,6)=1. Counts are arithmetic k-isomorphism classes; geometric automorphism groups are not classified. Publication priority remains a residual risk.
title: Ordinary twelve-point trigonal covers with a single Frobenius branch orbit
